name: vLLM (Omni serving path)
description: vLLM's serving stack applied to diffusion outputs: the OpenAI-shaped server, the scheduler and the memory manager that serve text models, answering /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits instead of /v1/chat/completions. Registered as its own engine rather than as a flag on `vllm` because it is a different API surface and a different model-support matrix — a result here says nothing about the same version's text serving, and averaging the two into one coverage square would be wrong.

serve.notes: The template is the invocation this engine is described by; confirm it against the installed build before quoting it in a result's serve_command, which must be the command that was actually run.

notes: Image requests carry their own parameters and the names differ between engines: this one takes true_cfg_scale where SGLang-Diffusion takes guidance_scale. The harness maps them from one canonical set (atlas_bench/images.py), and the value that was sent belongs in the result's args either way. versions_available is empty on purpose. A version file has to carry that build's real flags and their real defaults (AGENTS.md), and a wrong default silently merges two configurations into one fingerprint. Nobody has installed this engine for this model yet, so the first run that does reads `--help` on the actual build and adds the version file in the same pull request as its numbers.
